description: This file defines the LandingPage component and its subcomponents for the Applicant Portal frontend, utilizing React, React Router, Framer Motion, and FontAwesome for UI elements and icons.

methods.name: LandingPage
methods.description: Main functional component rendering the landing page layout with navigation, hero section, features, trust strip, FAQ, and footer.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering the top navigation bar with logo, menu links, and call-to-action buttons.

methods.name: Hero
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering the hero section with animated heading, description, call-to-action, and layered illustrations.

methods.name: Features
methods.description: Subcomponent displaying feature cards highlighting security, decision speed, and rates.

methods.name: TrustStrip
methods.description: Subcomponent showing trust metrics, partner logos, and funding information.

methods.name: Faq
methods.description: Subcomponent with an FAQ section answering common questions about the product.

methods.name: Footer
methods.description: Subcomponent displaying the footer with company info, navigation links, and legal disclaimers.
